At the University of Edinburgh JOHN BLAIR-FISH is studying meteorology and in his spare time has taken to fell running with some success, wearing Belgrave colours on Scottish hills that have not previously seen the "claret and gold".

John Blair-Fish continues his fell running activities up North. On April 6th he finished 28th in the Pendle Fell Race and three weeks later was placed 3rd in the Goatfell Hill Race at Brodick, Isle of Arran.

John Blair-Fish is still running well over the fells up North. Making a welcome visit south over the Christmas period was JOHN BLAIR-FISH who led our small team home over at Blackheath. On Boxing Day he teamed up with his brother PETER and sister to enter the Chipstead Pram Race and finished a worthy second behind one JOHN THRESHER.

On September 6th in the Ben Nevis Fell Race, a category A event over 10 miles and climbing 4418 feet, John Blair-Fish improved yet again. His record now reads - 1973 27th 2:03, 1974 22nd 1:45, 1975 13th 1:41:27.
John Blair-Fish finished a worthy 6th overall in the 1975 Fell Runner of the Year competition, scores being calculated on each participants best 12 runs out of a possible 23 category 'A' fell races.
